result.summary: One likely visual issue is present: a loading indicator appears to be stuck over a fully rendered restaurant image.

issues.description: A white circular loading spinner with a green progress arc is displayed in the center of the Tokomaru Ramen Bar image, even though the image content is already visible. This obscures the restaurant artwork and makes the card look unfinished or stuck loading.
issues.suggestion: Hide the loading indicator once the image and restaurant card data have loaded, or replace it with an intentional overlay/control if loading is still in progress.
